root_cause: Provider paid out the Sep 30 holiday balance (14.5 days) and missed October accrual for the leaver.
disposition: Workday balance is the system of record. Ask provider to pay the extra accrued days on a supplementary run.

root_cause: Provider paid the full month to a leaver terminated Oct 15 (termination event ignored).
disposition: Overpayment of half a month. Provider to recover from final settlement; raise a service ticket.

root_cause: Provider payslip shows earned leave of 14.0 days; Workday shows 15.0 after accrual and the Oct 22 half-day. Provider did not load the October absence file.
disposition: Workday is the source of truth for balances printed on payslips. Provider to reload absence and reissue payslip.

root_cause: Salary increase effective Oct 12 reached the provider after the Oct 12 change cutoff; provider paid the old salary for the full month.
disposition: Workday is correct. Provider pays the Oct 12–31 difference as arrears in November; track on the cutover issue log.

root_cause: Provider computed employer PF on full basic, without the ₹15,000 wage ceiling.
disposition: Workday applies the ceiling (max ₹1,800). Ask provider to configure the PF wage ceiling; credit note for the overcharge.

root_cause: Sign-on bonus one-time payment was sent on a late PECI file and not processed this month.
disposition: Pay in the November run (or supplementary). Confirm the PECI late-change process.
